findings.issue: GET /books/:id/reviews does not validate that the book exists, unlike the sibling /books/:id/histogram and /books/:id routes.
findings.evidence: router.get('/books/:id/reviews', ...) calls Stats.getReviewsSorted(bookId, sort) directly without checking Book.getBookById(bookId); a nonexistent book id returns 200 [] instead of 404.

findings.issue: page/pageSize of 0 or non-numeric input are silently coerced to defaults (1/10) via `|| 1`/`|| 10` before the validation check, so invalid values like page=0 or page=abc never trigger the intended 400 response.
